repositories.name: Loongphy/codex-auth
repositories.scope: highest-reputation native Codex switcher checked here; not an exhaustive survey of candidate repositories

limitations: active auth snapshots can be captured before switching, but no cross-process lock serializes a concurrent refresh against the switch copy
daemon reload can defer while a turn is active
fallback daemon restart can interrupt attached sessions
shared auth does not provide concurrent independent per-session accounts

relevant_open_issues.topic: report of stale in-memory refresh token invalidating auth after switching
request for one-shot automatic account switching
request for concurrent CLI processes with different account contexts
WSL CLI exit leaves app-server daemon using old account
shared app-server daemon cache means ordinary CLI restart keeps old account; current source adds opt-in daemon coordination

test_run.fake_boundary: temporary HOME and CODEX_HOME; synthetic auth fixtures; fake Codex daemon scripts and test curl helpers; no provider request or model RPC
